title: College Basketball
description:
NJIT at Rutgers
The NJIT Highlanders visit the Rutgers Scarlet Knights for an NCAA Division I game. NJIT aims to break a two-game skid with guard Victor Vanderstraeten, and Rutgers comes off an 81-54 win over New Haven playing inside Jersey Mike's Arena.

title: College Basketball
description:
Fairfield at Wisconsin
The Fairfield Stags visit the Wisconsin Badgers for an NCAA Division I game in Madison. Fairfield comes off a 79-67 loss to Vermont alongside guard Declan Wucherpfennig, and Wisconsin rides a two-game win streak with guard Eian Elmer at Kohl Center.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
College of Charleston at USC
The Charleston Cougars visit the No. 3 USC Trojans for an NCAA Division I game in California. Charleston comes off a 92-43 victory over Berry alongside forward Dakara Merthie, and USC enters with a 100-68 win over UNLV with guard Jazzy Davidson.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Northern Iowa at Iowa
The No. 10 Iowa Hawkeyes host the Northern Iowa Panthers at Carver-Hawkeye Arena. Iowa looks to clamp down defensively following a 91-79 loss, while Northern Iowa aim to bounce back after falling 76-54 on the road against South Dakota State.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Arizona at UCLA
The Arizona Wildcats face the No. 10 UCLA Bruins for an NCAA Division I game in California. Arizona comes off a 74-61 victory over Iona alongside Breanna Williams, and UCLA enters with a 78-42 win against UC Irvine with Sienna Betts.
